claims.claim: Prospective KA-01 documentation and the single-NEXT roadmap select TASK-424 while retaining bounded-primary v2, retired planning packages, and earlier immutable lineage.

The ordinary Codex adapter implements a separately consented interactive path using one native app-server process, private stdio connection, and logical thread with correlated completed turns and explicit STOP guards.

Runtime authenticates clean committed candidates, executes original authored proof preterminal, seals native checkpoints, and prepares bounded factual feedback only for complete stable eligible failures.

Correction acceptance checks original process/session/profile/lease authority, exact feedback receipt, distinct scoped descendant commits, checkpoint lineage, and verified reduction of failed native identities.
Protected Runtime effects enforce the existing correction, checkpoint, wall-time, and cumulative verification limits; terminal completion consumes the final checkpoint without repeating verification.

Interactive PRIMARY requires version-3 selection and fresh authenticated per-RUN consent; v1 preactivation, v2 bounded-primary, nonopted legacy execution, and unsupported correction opt-ins retain separate routes.

Focused test definitions include mandatory installed-Codex C1/F1/C2 execution and deterministic negative cases; native unavailability fails visibly as BLOCKER instead of skipping or substituting fixture conformance.
The original Runtime emits bounded source/session/turn, checkpoint/correction, verification-budget, unavailable-evidence, and final-status observations without review or publication outcome claims.
